entries.name: TEST_Hollowkin
entries.text:
TEST_Hollowkin Traits
Your hollowkin character has the following traits.
Ability Score Increase. Your Wisdom score increases by 2.
Age. Hollowkin mature at 20 and live about 120 years.
Size. Hollowkin stand between 5 and 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.
Speed. Your base walking speed is 30 feet.
Languages. You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

entries.name: TEST_Path of Embers
entries.text:
TEST_Path of Embers
Some wardens carry a smoldering coal in their chests.

Ember Heart
Starting when you choose this path at 3rd level, you have resistance to fire damage while raging.

Cinder Step
Beginning at 6th level, when you move on your turn while raging, you can ignite the ground you leave behind.

entries.name: TEST_Sure-Footed
entries.text:
TEST_Sure-Footed
Prerequisite: Dexterity 13 or higher
You have practiced moving over broken ground. You gain the following benefits:
• Difficult terrain doesn’t cost you extra movement.
• You have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone.
